title: TS6500 CARTRIDGE MIXER – Mixer for 2.5, 6 and 80Z Cartridge Kits
description: Provides automatic mixing of standard two part cartridges. Automatic fluid level sensing and hardener injection. • Universal power supply for worldwide use • Automatic fluid level sensing-no need to set stroke length • Robust, high torque motor handles high viscosity material • Safety enclosure, emergency stop and two-hand start • Programmable memories store most frequently used mix cycles • Quick and easy to replace cartridge holder – no tools needed • User friendly for easy setup • Strong, heavy platform for heavy industrial use • RoHs, WEEEE Compliance
